network_status.network: Ripristino del ponte sul Rio Piazzina dopo la tempesta Vaia
network_status.summary_it: La Provincia documenta la completa demolizione dell'impalcato sul Rio Piazzina e la dinamica erosiva alla confluenza con il Rio Cadino, ma non pubblica livelli o portate evento-specifici alla sezione.
network_status.summary_en: The Province documents complete loss of the Rio Piazzina deck and erosion at its confluence with Rio Cadino but publishes no event-specific stage or discharge at the section.

provenance.method: Manual extraction encoded in the ARCUS event-report curation registry

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
